13383 Oakalla Road
Killeen, TX 76549
$415,000, 1,280 SF, MLS# 554755

Are you ready for a weekend retreat? This property is exactly what you are looking for! 20.18 acres of land, with water and electricity and right off of Oakalla Road. Electrical hook ups for an RV are at the garage. Water is available. Hunting is allowed. Live in the mobile home that is on the property, or in your RV while you build your dream home. The taxes are low, and the property will qualify for an ag exemption if you choose to have livestock, which will lower the taxes even more! This property is fully fenced and gated. 
Minutes from Killeen and Copperas Cove, and about an hour from the Austin area, makes this a great location.
This is a great property, and is priced to sell!
